title: Symmetry reductions of a generalized Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation via equivalence transformations
source_context:
The Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation u t + β 1 ​ u x ​ x + β 2 ​ u x ​ x ​ x ​ x + δ ​ u x ​ x ​ x + u ​ u x = 0 , u_{t}+\beta_{1}u_{xx}+\beta_{2}u_{xxxx}+\delta u_{xxx}+uu_{x}=0, (1) arises in the modelling of flow on an inclined plane, where β 1 \beta_{1} , β 2 \beta_{2} and δ \delta are constants. This equation was introduced by Kuramoto [ 20 ] in
one-spatial dimension for the study of phase turbulance in the Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction. Sivashinsky derived it independently in the context of small thermal diffusive instabilities for laminar flame fronts. Some authors have previously studied this equation [ 18 , 19 ] .
